# Dateless on purpose: the load script materialises it from --start over a horizon.

kind: routine

description: Synthetic weekly care pattern; open-ended.

daily        | face      | Morning face       | 07:00 | 5       | cleanse, moisturise, SPF

mon,thu      | shampoo   | Wash               | 07:10 | 10      | lukewarm water; scalp only
